correctness.rationale: Gaussian radial factorization for homogeneous quadratic harmonics cancels radius and halves the antipodally invariant event to obtain the single positive coordinate-dominant face. Permutation and independent sign symmetry split the trace-free quadratic space into four orthogonal invariant sectors with dimensions 1,d-1,(d-1)(d-2)/2,d-2; these sum to d(d+1)/2-1. Conditioning on the maximum of d independent chi-square(1) variables gives the four displayed expectations with denominator 2d(d-1),1,1,4, yielding stated eigenvalues. The inequalities 0<a(y)<y/3, v(y)<2a(y)^2 and positivity of an exponential covariance plus C>0 support strict Z>M>C>D; independent numerical quadrature checked dimensions 4,5,10,100,1000 and trace positivity. The maximum satisfies M/(2log d)->1 in L2 and truncated a(M)->1, v(M)->2, giving lambda_Z~(log d)^2/d and lambda_D~1/(2d), hence kappa~2(log d)^2. Numeric tests do not replace infinite-dimension arguments; full proof contains needed comparisons.
